demand.w7.pub.clubStanding: 上赛季周日联赛乙组第 7 名，队史首次实现全队出勤率过半。
demand.w7.pub.clubStandingEn: Finished 7th in Sunday League Division Two last season — the first time in club history that more than half the squad turned up.
demand.w7.pub.clubBest: 历史最佳：社区杯八强；那次晋级靠的是对手全队赛前食物中毒。
demand.w7.pub.clubBestEn: Best ever: Community Cup quarter-finals — reached thanks to the opponents' entire squad getting food poisoning the night before.
demand.w7.pub.clubProfile: 预算来自吧台薯条收入，战术板挂在啤酒龙头旁边。队规第一条：比赛日晚上不许喝醉——Jack 上周刚打破了它。
demand.w7.pub.clubProfileEn: Budget funded by bar chip sales; the tactics board hangs next to the beer taps. Club rule No. 1: no getting drunk on match nights — Jack broke it last week.
demand.w7.pub.descriptionEn:
We've hit a bit of a snag. Our first-choice striker Jack celebrated a touch too hard last night — he's still hungover and definitely won't make Saturday's match against the pub next door.

Any chance you've got a striker who could fill in for us, just for one game?
demand.w7.pub.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 1 week of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w7.pub.expirySubjectEn: Hold off on the striker hunt
demand.w7.pub.expiryBody: 朋友，先别找了。Jack 已经醒酒，发誓本周只喝无酒精啤酒，周末能上。另外酒保说他表弟也能踢前锋。委托先撤了，改天请你来喝一杯，第一杯算我们的。
demand.w7.pub.expiryBodyEn: Mate, call off the search. Jack has sobered up and sworn to drink only alcohol-free beer this week — he's good for Saturday. Also, the barman says his cousin can play up front. We're withdrawing the request; come by for a pint some time, first one's on us.

clubRequestMail.sender: 黑麦酒馆 · 店主兼教练
clubRequestMail.subject: 周末救命：求一名前锋
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Weekend SOS: striker needed
clubRequestMail.preview: Jack 又喝多了，我们需要一个能站直的人。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: Jack's drunk again. We need someone who can stand upright.
clubRequestMail.body: 兄弟，长话短说。我们的主力前锋 Jack 昨晚为庆祝自己打进本月唯一进球，一直庆祝到了今天早上。周末对阵醉鸭酒馆是德比，输不起。你手上有没有能顶一场的前锋？不要求多厉害，能自己系鞋带、跑两步就行。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: Mate, long story short. Our first-choice striker Jack celebrated his only goal of the month last night — and carried on celebrating until this morning. Saturday against the Drunken Duck is a derby and we cannot lose it. Got a striker who can fill in for one game? Doesn't need to be good — just able to tie his own boots and run a bit.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 酒馆门口手写启事 · 第一手信息
clubRequestMail.sourceNoteEn: Handwritten notice on the pub door · first-hand information

demand.w7.relegation.clubStanding: 上赛季葡超第 15 名，以两分优势保级成功，全城放了半小时烟花。
demand.w7.relegation.clubStandingEn: 15th in the Portuguese top flight last season, surviving by two points; the whole town set off fireworks for half an hour.
demand.w7.relegation.clubBest: 历史最佳：葡超第 8 名；俱乐部博物馆为那个赛季专门辟出一整面墙。
demand.w7.relegation.clubBestEn: Best ever: 8th in the Primeira Liga; the club museum dedicates an entire wall to that season.
demand.w7.relegation.clubProfile: 预算有限、焦虑无限。体育主管办公室挂着一张丢球原因分析图，图上只有一句话：后卫又没人了。
demand.w7.relegation.clubProfileEn: Limited budget, unlimited anxiety. The sporting director's office wall displays a goals-conceded analysis chart bearing a single sentence: we're out of defenders again.
demand.w7.relegation.titleEn: Relegation-threatened Primeira Liga club seeks defensive linchpin
demand.w7.relegation.descriptionEn:
We have a serious defensive problem. We've conceded far too many goals this season — the back line hasn't been stable for weeks, and it's wrecking our survival hopes.

So we're looking for an experienced defender. Someone calm, reliable, who steps up when it matters.
demand.w7.relegation.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 1 week of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w7.relegation.expirySubject: 防线引援计划终止通知
demand.w7.relegation.expiryBody: 先生您好。主席昨晚看了青年队比赛，认为那个 17 岁的小孩跑得挺快，决定内部挖潜。另外我们上赛季丢球纪录的保持者也同意再踢一年。委托取消，感谢理解——保级队的浪漫，您懂的。
demand.w7.relegation.expiryBodyEn: Dear Sir, the chairman watched the youth team last night, decided the 17-year-old lad runs quite fast, and opted to promote from within. Meanwhile the holder of last season's goals-conceded record has agreed to play on for another year. The request is cancelled — thank you for understanding. The romance of a relegation battle; you know how it is.

clubRequestMail.subject: 防线告急：诚聘后防核心
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Defence in crisis: seeking a defensive leader
clubRequestMail.preview: 我们本赛季的丢球数已经可以办展览了。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: This season's goals conceded could fill an exhibition.
clubRequestMail.body: 我们不得不承认：目前这条后防线是联赛的一道风景线——对手都爱来看。我们需要一名经验丰富、冷静可靠的后卫，关键时刻能站出来，最好还能顺便教会其他人怎么站。保级生死战，拜托了。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: We have to admit it: our current back line is one of the league's top attractions — opposing fans love coming to see it. We need an experienced, calm, dependable defender who steps up in the big moments and, ideally, teaches the others how to stand. It's a relegation dogfight. Please.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w8.gulf.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 3 名，目前在洲际赛事小组赛的投入榜上遥遥领先。
demand.w8.gulf.clubStandingEn: 3rd in the league last season; currently runaway leaders in continental group-stage spending.
demand.w8.gulf.clubBest: 历史最佳：联赛亚军；奖杯陈列室很大，目前主要用来陈列奖杯的预算单。
demand.w8.gulf.clubBestEn: Best ever: league runners-up. The trophy room is huge — at the moment it mainly displays the budget proposals for trophies.
demand.w8.gulf.clubProfile: 预算充足、舆论压力巨大。董事会把“重返亚洲之巅”印在每一个咖啡杯上，虽然球队从未到过亚洲之巅。
demand.w8.gulf.clubProfileEn: Budget: ample. Public pressure: immense. The board has printed "Return to the summit of Asia" on every coffee mug, despite the club never having been anywhere near the summit of Asia.
demand.w8.gulf.titleEn: Saudi club tables huge offer, seeks a famous name
demand.w8.gulf.descriptionEn:
What matters most is fame. We want to sign a player everyone knows — ideally with top-flight experience and real influence in the football world.

Money is no object.
demand.w8.gulf.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 2-3 weeks of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w8.gulf.expirySubjectEn: Change to the superstar signing plan
demand.w8.gulf.expiryBody: 尊敬的球探：董事会本周改变了主意——他们决定直接收购一家已经有巨星的俱乐部，这样更快。原委托即刻撤销。为表歉意，随信附赠俱乐部定制咖啡杯一个，镀金的。
demand.w8.gulf.expiryBodyEn: Dear Scout, the board has changed its mind this week — they've decided to simply buy a club that already has a superstar. It's quicker. The original request is withdrawn with immediate effect. By way of apology, please find enclosed an official club coffee mug. Gold-plated.

clubRequestMail.sender: 金沙联 · 全球招募总监
clubRequestMail.senderEn: Golden Dune United · Director of Global Recruitment
clubRequestMail.subject: 诚聘知名球星，预算面谈
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Seeking a famous star; budget negotiable
clubRequestMail.preview: 钱不是问题，名气才是。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: Money is no object — fame is.
clubRequestMail.body: 我们寻找的是一张脸——最好登上过杂志封面、让机场瘫痪过的那种。球技当然重要，但球衣销量和社交热度同样会进入评估。如果您手上有这样的名字，请直接联系。报价单已经打印好了，空白处填数字就行。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: We're after a face — ideally one that's been on magazine covers and shut down airports. Ability matters, of course, but shirt sales and social-media buzz go into the assessment too. If you have such a name, contact us directly. The offer sheet is already printed; just fill in the number.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w9.availability.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 11 名，本赛季医务室使用率高居联盟第一。
demand.w9.availability.clubStandingEn: 11th in the league last season; this season we top the league for treatment-room usage.
demand.w9.availability.clubBest: 历史最佳：杯赛四强；那年的纪念围巾现在还挂在车间休息室里。
demand.w9.availability.clubBestEn: Best ever: cup semi-finalists; the commemorative scarf still hangs in the factory break room.
demand.w9.availability.clubProfile: 由工厂工会持股，预算与加班费挂钩。队医拥有俱乐部最高决策权——他刚刚宣布绷带库存告急。
demand.w9.availability.clubProfileEn: Owned by the factory union; the budget is pegged to overtime pay. The club doctor holds the ultimate decision-making power — and he's just declared the bandage reserves critically low.
demand.w9.availability.titleEn: Please, find me someone who can actually keep playing
demand.w9.availability.descriptionEn:
We've already lost 7 players to injury. The boss doesn't want to hear about ability any more — he only asks one question:

"Is he injury-prone?"

If the answer is no, everything else is negotiable.
demand.w9.availability.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 2-3 weeks of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w9.availability.expiryBody: 好消息：理疗室昨晚一下走出了四个人，阵容突然够用了。老板决定再观察观察。委托先撤，感谢您跑这一趟——顺便问下，您那里有二手拐杖吗？我们想囤几副备用。
demand.w9.availability.expiryBodyEn: Good news: four players walked out of the physio room last night, so the squad suddenly looks big enough. The boss wants to wait and see. Request withdrawn — thanks for your trouble. By the way, do you happen to have any second-hand crutches? We'd like to stockpile a few, just in case.

clubRequestMail.subject: 全员伤病，急求耐用型中场
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Squad-wide injuries; durable midfielder wanted
clubRequestMail.preview: 我们只想问一个问题：他容易受伤吗？
clubRequestMail.previewEn: We have just one question: is he injury-prone?
clubRequestMail.body: 直说了吧：我们现在有七个人躺在医务室，理疗床已经开始排班。老板不想听任何技术统计，只关心一件事——这人能不能从周一站到周六。如果您推荐的人过去三年没进过医务室，请务必把他介绍给我们。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: Let's be blunt: seven of our lads are currently in the treatment room, and the physio beds now run on a rota. The boss doesn't want to hear any stats — only whether the man can stay on his feet from Monday to Saturday. If your candidate hasn't seen the inside of a treatment room in three years, introduce him immediately.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w10.japan.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 6 名，全队跑动距离第一、射门次数倒数第一。
demand.w10.japan.clubStandingEn: 6th in the league last season: first for distance run, dead last for shots taken.
demand.w10.japan.clubBest: 历史最佳：联赛第 4 名；庆祝方式是全体加跑十公里，此后再没人敢进前四。
demand.w10.japan.clubBestEn: Best ever: 4th in the league; celebrated with a mandatory 10k run for the whole squad. Nobody has dared finish top four since.
demand.w10.japan.clubProfile: 老板的哲学：技术是玄学，跑动是科学。训练基地墙上只有一行字——90 分钟后还在跑的人，才是我们的人。
demand.w10.japan.clubProfileEn: The owner's philosophy: technique is superstition, running is science. One line on the training-ground wall: if he's still running after 90 minutes, he's one of ours.
demand.w10.japan.titleEn: We plan to run the opposition into the ground
demand.w10.japan.descriptionEn:
The boss doesn't care about goals at all. Only superhuman stamina and running power.

The forward should terrify every opponent in Japan with sheer running.

"If he can still run after 90 minutes, he's our player."
demand.w10.japan.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 2-3 weeks of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w10.japan.expiryBody: 抱歉通知您：老板在马拉松赛道上直接签下了三个人——他们跑了 42 公里还能笑，就是我们要的人。原委托取消。感谢您的时间，也欢迎您下赛季来看我们跑……不，比赛。
demand.w10.japan.expiryBodyEn: Sorry to inform you: the boss signed three players straight off a marathon course — they'd run 42 km and were still smiling, which makes them exactly our kind. The original request is cancelled. Thanks for your time, and do come watch us run next season — sorry, play.

clubRequestMail.sender: 湾岸闪电 · 主教练办公室
clubRequestMail.senderEn: Bayside Lightning FC · Head Coach's Office
clubRequestMail.subject: 寻找跑不死的前锋
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Wanted: a forward who cannot stop running
clubRequestMail.preview: 进球可以商量，跑不动免谈。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: Goals negotiable. Not running? Non-negotiable.
clubRequestMail.body: 我们的打法很简单：把球传向对方半场，然后所有人一起追。老板不看射门集锦，只看跑动热图，颜色越红越好。我们需要一名前锋，职责是让日本所有后卫做同一个噩梦——他为什么还在跑？
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: Our style is simple: punt the ball into their half, then everyone chases it. The boss doesn't watch goal compilations, only running heat maps — the redder the better. We need a forward whose job is to give every defender in Japan the same nightmare: why is he still running?
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w10.orange.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 5 名，控球率稳居前三，禁区内触球次数保密。
demand.w10.orange.clubStandingEn: 5th in the league last season; possession stats comfortably top three. Touches in the opposition box: classified.
demand.w10.orange.clubBest: 历史最佳：联赛亚军；最近一次发生在俱乐部仍用传真机的年代，那台传真机至今留作纪念。
demand.w10.orange.clubBestEn: Best ever: league runners-up — back in the era when the club still used the fax machine. The fax machine is kept to this day as a memento.
demand.w10.orange.clubProfile: 主教练是光头，战术手册厚达四百页，其中三百页讲门将如何用脚。俱乐部把“门将是第一进攻发起者”印在每一条围巾上。
demand.w10.orange.clubProfileEn: The manager is bald, his tactical manual runs to four hundred pages, and three hundred of them cover how goalkeepers should use their feet. The club prints "the goalkeeper is the first playmaker" on every scarf.
demand.w10.orange.titleEn: A bald Dutch coach's request for a goalkeeper
demand.w10.orange.descriptionEn: We don't need a keeper who just stands on his line. Modern football demands a keeper who plays — he must help us control the tempo and act as our first playmaker from the back.
demand.w10.orange.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 1 week of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w10.orange.expiryBody: 经教练组研究决定：现有门将的传球成功率已经可以原谅他的扑救。另外青训营发现一个会踢任意球的小孩，先内部提拔。委托撤回。本函已由传真机确认收到，请放心。
demand.w10.orange.expiryBodyEn: Following deliberation, the coaching staff have decided the current goalkeeper's pass completion fully excuses his shot-stopping. The academy has also unearthed a kid who can take free-kicks, so we'll promote internally. Request withdrawn. This letter has been receipt-confirmed by the fax machine, so rest assured.

clubRequestMail.subject: 寻找会踢球的门将
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Seeking a goalkeeper who can actually play
clubRequestMail.preview: 站在门线上等球的，请勿投简历。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: If you just wait on the line for the ball, don't apply.
clubRequestMail.body: 我们对门将的要求写在战术板第一行：你是我们的第一名中场，只是顺便戴副手套。他要参与组织、控制节奏，把后场变成进攻的起点。扑救当然也要会，但那只是面试的第二轮。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: Our requirement for a goalkeeper is written on the first line of the tactics board: you are our first midfielder — you just happen to wear gloves. He must join the build-up, dictate tempo, and turn the back line into the start of the attack. Shot-stopping is required too, of course, but that's only the second round of the interview.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w11.valley.clubStanding: 上赛季地区联赛第 2 名，升级附加赛最后一分钟被角球绝杀，全镇默哀三天。
demand.w11.valley.clubStandingEn: 2nd in the regional league last season; lost the promotion play-off to a last-minute corner. The whole town observed three days of mourning.
demand.w11.valley.clubBest: 历史最佳：全国业余杯十六强；那场的球票根至今是镇议会的抵押物。
demand.w11.valley.clubBestEn: Best ever: last 16 of the national amateur cup; the ticket stubs from that match are still held by the town council as collateral.
demand.w11.valley.clubProfile: 全队预算不如职业队一名替补的周薪，但全镇 4000 名居民都是股东。酒吧、面包房和邮局都在等“职业球队”这块招牌。
demand.w11.valley.clubProfileEn: The entire squad budget wouldn't cover one pro club substitute's weekly wage — but all 4,000 townsfolk are shareholders. The pub, the bakery and the post office are all waiting for the words "professional club" on the sign.
demand.w11.valley.descriptionEn: We'd like a player with top-flight experience to help us push for the professional league. This little town needs a professional club.
demand.w11.valley.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 4 weeks of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w11.valley.expiryBody: 球探先生，抱歉。镇议会投票决定，今年预算优先修镇口那座桥——桥塌了比降级更丢人。引援委托暂缓，等桥修好再谈。也欢迎您来谷城做客，桥修好后路会好走很多。
demand.w11.valley.expiryBodyEn: Dear Scout, our apologies. The town council has voted to prioritise repairing the bridge at the town entrance with this year's budget — a collapsed bridge is more embarrassing than relegation. The recruitment request is on hold until the bridge is fixed. You're welcome in Valley Town any time; the road in will be much smoother once it's done.

clubRequestMail.subject: 小镇需要一个见过大场面的中场
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: A small town needs a midfielder who's seen the big time
clubRequestMail.preview: 全镇 4000 人的职业梦，就差一块拼图。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: 4,000 people share one pro dream. One piece is missing.
clubRequestMail.body: 我们镇上有酒吧、面包房、邮局，和一支差点升级的球队。我们缺一名踢过顶级联赛的中场——不用他场场拼命，只要让小伙子们看看“职业”两个字怎么写。这座小镇需要一支职业球队，而我们需要您找到那个人。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: Our town has a pub, a bakery, a post office, and a team that nearly won promotion. We lack a midfielder who's played top-flight football — he doesn't need to run himself into the ground, just show the lads what "professional" looks like. This town needs a professional club, and we need you to find that man.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w11.office.clubStanding: 上赛季企业联赛 B 组第 4 名，其中三场胜利来自对手加班弃权。
demand.w11.office.clubStandingEn: 4th in Corporate League Group B last season — three of those wins came from opponents forfeiting due to overtime.
demand.w11.office.clubBest: 历史最佳：企业杯亚军；决赛输球后，CEO 把对方公司的供应商合同全砍了。
demand.w11.office.clubBestEn: Best ever: Corporate Cup runners-up; after losing the final, the CEO cancelled all of the other company's supplier contracts.
demand.w11.office.clubProfile: 预算视季度财报浮动，训练安排在午休。现任门将的眼睛会在对方射门瞬间自动闭合，HR 认为这属于工伤。
demand.w11.office.clubProfileEn: Budget fluctuates with the quarterly report; training happens at lunch. The current keeper's eyes close automatically at the moment of a shot — HR classes it as a workplace injury.
demand.w11.office.descriptionEn:
Hello — our current goalkeeper closes his eyes every time the opposition shoots.

Next week's match against the company next door is a big one. We're after a keeper who at least won't duck the ball. Whether he saves it can wait.
demand.w11.office.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 4 weeks of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w11.office.expiryBody: 您好，情况有变：我们的门将在体检中查出瞬目反射过于健康，医生建议他改打后卫。另外市场部总监主动请缨守门——他说他常年替整个部门背锅，经验丰富。委托撤销，感谢。
demand.w11.office.expiryBodyEn: Hello — situation update: our keeper's medical found his blink reflex is far too healthy, so the doctor recommends he move to defence. Meanwhile the marketing director has volunteered for goal — he says he's spent years taking the blame for his entire department, so he's highly experienced. Request withdrawn, with thanks.

clubRequestMail.sender: 附件科技 · 工会文体部
clubRequestMail.senderEn: Attachment Tech FC · Union Recreation Department
clubRequestMail.subject: 急聘：一名睁眼守门员
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Urgent: one open-eyed goalkeeper
clubRequestMail.preview: 我们的门将需要一个不闭眼的替补，或者接班人。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: Our keeper needs a deputy who doesn't blink — or a successor.
clubRequestMail.body: 您好，打扰了。我们是一家正规注册的企业足球队，目前遇到一个技术难题：门将看到射门会闭眼。下周五对隔壁公司的比赛关系到年度团建经费归属，不容有失。我们需要一名至少敢于直视足球飞行的门将，扑救成功率可以慢慢培养。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: Hello, sorry to bother you. We are a properly registered company football team with a technical problem: our goalkeeper closes his eyes when he sees a shot. Next Friday's match against the company next door decides this year's team-building budget, and failure is not an option. We need a keeper who at least dares to watch the ball fly. Save percentage can be developed later.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 企业内部邮件转发 · 来源可靠
clubRequestMail.sourceNoteEn: Forwarded internal company email · reliable source

demand.w12.leader.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 9 名，保持着丢球后全队沉默时长的联赛纪录。
demand.w12.leader.clubStandingEn: 9th in the league last season; holders of the league record for longest total squad silence after conceding.
demand.w12.leader.clubBest: 历史最佳：联赛第 3 名；据说那年更衣室里有位会骂人的老队长，可惜他已退役去养海鸥了。
demand.w12.leader.clubBestEn: Best ever: 3rd in the league; rumour says the dressing room had an old captain who knew how to swear back then. Sadly he's retired to raise seagulls.
demand.w12.leader.clubProfile: 主场常年大雾，能见度低到客队经常找不到球门——我们依然丢球。更衣室安静得像图书馆，教练希望有人能制造点噪音。
demand.w12.leader.clubProfileEn: The home ground sits in permanent fog, with visibility so low away teams often can't find the goal — we still concede. The dressing room is library-quiet; the coach wants someone to make some noise.
demand.w12.leader.descriptionEn:
When our defenders concede, nobody says anything — they just stand there watching.
We want someone with a big voice who can at least swear a bit after a goal goes in.
demand.w12.leader.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 4 weeks of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w12.leader.expiryBody: 先生，不必麻烦了。昨晚队内会议，替补门将终于开口骂了十五分钟，据说内容震撼人心、词汇丰富，队友纷纷表示被打醒了。教练决定让他改踢中卫。委托撤销，感谢您的倾听。
demand.w12.leader.expiryBodyEn: Sir, no need to trouble yourself. At last night's team meeting the backup keeper finally opened his mouth and swore for fifteen straight minutes — reportedly soul-stirring stuff with an impressive vocabulary, and the lads all say they feel wide awake now. The coach is moving him to centre-back. Request withdrawn; thank you for listening.

clubRequestMail.sender: 雾港 · 一线队教练组
clubRequestMail.subject: 求一名会骂人的后卫
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Wanted: a defender who can swear
clubRequestMail.preview: 我们丢球后的更衣室，安静得能听见海鸥叫。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: After we concede, the dressing room is quiet enough to hear the seagulls.
clubRequestMail.body: 我们的后卫人都是好人，就是太客气。丢球以后没人说话，大家就站在那里看，仿佛在欣赏对方进球的艺术性。我们需要一名后防领袖：嗓门大、心脏硬，丢球后能第一个骂两句——骂醒自己人就行，裁判那边我们来处理。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: Our defenders are all lovely people — that's the problem. After we concede, nobody says a word; they just stand there watching, as if admiring the artistic merit of the opponent's goal. We need a defensive leader: big voice, hard heart, first to let rip after a goal goes in — just enough to wake our own lot up. We'll handle the referee.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w12.utility.clubStanding: 上赛季群岛联赛第 5 名，全联盟注册球员人数最少纪录保持者。
demand.w12.utility.clubStandingEn: 5th in the Islands League last season; record holders for the smallest registered squad in the league.
demand.w12.utility.clubBest: 历史最佳：岛际杯冠军；那届另外两座岛因为台风没来参赛。
demand.w12.utility.clubBestEn: Best ever: Inter-Island Cup winners — the other two islands didn't show up that year because of a typhoon.
demand.w12.utility.clubProfile: 球队分布在三个岛上，客场要坐船，晕船率直接影响首发名单。阵容单薄到队医都要客串边后卫——他踢得还不错。
demand.w12.utility.clubProfileEn: The squad is spread across three islands; away trips are by boat, and the seasickness rate directly shapes the starting XI. The squad is so thin the club doctor has to fill in at full-back — he's actually decent.
demand.w12.utility.titleEn: We are desperately short of players
demand.w12.utility.descriptionEn:
Ideally he can play up front, on the wing, in midfield — even at the back if needed.
In short, one man does the job of three.
demand.w12.utility.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 4 weeks of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w12.utility.expiryBody: 您好，委托撤销。昨天青训营来了三胞胎兄弟，三个人加起来能踢九个位置，还只需要三份盒饭。经理当场拍板签约。抱歉让您白忙，欢迎您冬天来岛上看球，船票自理。
demand.w12.utility.expiryBodyEn: Hello — request withdrawn. Yesterday a set of triplets turned up at the academy: between the three of them they cover nine positions and only need three lunch boxes. The manager signed them on the spot. Sorry for the wasted effort; you're welcome to come watch a match on the islands in winter — ferry tickets at your own expense.

clubRequestMail.subject: 诚聘一个顶三个的中场
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Seeking a midfielder who does the job of three
clubRequestMail.preview: 我们的替补席，风比人多。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: On our bench, there's more wind than people.
clubRequestMail.body: 跟您说实话：我们缺人缺得厉害。名单上写着十五个人，能同时出现在同一片球场上的不超过十二个。我们需要一名全能型球员，前锋、中场、后卫都能踢——最好还会开船，客场路上能搭把手。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: Honestly: we're desperately short of bodies. Fifteen names on the squad list, never more than twelve on the same pitch at once. We need a genuine utility man — striker, midfield, defence, the lot. Bonus points if he can drive a boat and lend a hand on away trips.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w13.dirty.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 8 名，犯规总数联盟前三，净胜球为负但对手瘀青数为正。
demand.w13.dirty.clubStandingEn: 8th in the league last season; top three for total fouls. Goal difference: negative. Opponent bruise count: positive.
demand.w13.dirty.clubBest: 历史最佳：杯赛八强；那年的比赛录像被对手当作伤情鉴定证据保存至今。
demand.w13.dirty.clubBestEn: Best ever: cup quarter-finalists; opponents from that run still keep the match footage as evidence for their injury assessments.
demand.w13.dirty.clubProfile: 主场草皮质量联盟倒数第一，球到这里会主动减速。球迷认为漂亮的传球是懦夫行为，铲球声才是最动听的助威歌。
demand.w13.dirty.clubProfileEn: The pitch is officially the worst in the league — the ball slows down out of respect. The fans consider a pretty pass an act of cowardice; the sound of a tackle is their favourite chant.
demand.w13.dirty.titleEn: We need someone for the dirty work
demand.w13.dirty.descriptionEn:
Our matches often turn into brawls.
We'd like a defender who doesn't mind tackling, heading, and winning ugly.
demand.w13.dirty.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 1 week of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w13.dirty.expiryBody: 先生您好，情况变化：上赛季跟我们踢得最凶的那支球队解散了，他们的队长自由身加盟——最了解我们打法的人，就是挨过我们打的人。委托关闭。另附创可贴一包，不成敬意。
demand.w13.dirty.expiryBodyEn: Dear Sir, situation update: the team that kicked us hardest last season has folded, and their captain has joined us on a free — nobody understands our style like a man who's been on the receiving end of it. Request closed. Please find a pack of plasters enclosed, as a small token.

clubRequestMail.subject: 寻找一名不怕脏活的后卫
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Seeking a defender unafraid of the dirty work
clubRequestMail.preview: 我们的比赛经常变成肉搏战，需要一个享受这一点的人。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: Our matches keep turning into brawls. We need someone who enjoys that.
clubRequestMail.body: 先声明：我们这里不踢漂亮足球。草皮一般，对抗管够，裁判的哨子经常忙不过来。我们需要一名后卫，不介意铲球、不介意争顶、不介意比赛踢得难看——如果能顺便让对方前锋做噩梦，奖金面谈。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: Full disclosure: we don't do pretty football here. Average pitch, unlimited contact, and the referee's whistle can't keep up. We need a defender who doesn't mind tackling, doesn't mind heading, and doesn't mind an ugly game — and if he can give their strikers nightmares on the side, the bonus is negotiable.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w13.stamina.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 7 名，上半场积分榜第 2，下半场积分榜倒数第 2。
demand.w13.stamina.clubStandingEn: 7th in the league last season: 2nd in the first-half table, second from bottom in the second-half table.
demand.w13.stamina.clubBest: 历史最佳：联赛第 5 名；那年所有主场比赛都在中午开球，据说球员的午睡习惯帮了大忙。
demand.w13.stamina.clubBestEn: Best ever: 5th in the league — the year every home game kicked off at noon, and the players' napping habits are said to have helped enormously.
demand.w13.stamina.clubProfile: 更衣室贴着标语：足球比赛有两个半场——这是主教练用惨痛学费学会的。体能教练上月辞职，理由是无法解释的现象。
demand.w13.stamina.clubProfileEn: A slogan in the dressing room reads: a football match has two halves — a lesson the head coach paid painful tuition to learn. The fitness coach quit last month, citing an unexplained phenomenon.
demand.w13.stamina.descriptionEn:
Our striker plays like a world-beater in the first half, then basically disappears.
So this time we ask only one thing: that we can still see him after 90 minutes.
demand.w13.stamina.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 1 week of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w13.stamina.expiryBody: 球探先生：经队医团队研究，前锋下半场消失的原因找到了——午餐吃太饱。俱乐部已更换食堂供应商，下周起改吃三明治。引援委托取消，感谢您的时间，也感谢食堂阿姨的配合。
demand.w13.stamina.expiryBodyEn: Dear Scout: after a thorough study, the medical team has found why our strikers vanish after half-time — lunch was too big. The club has changed canteen supplier; sandwiches from next week. The recruitment request is cancelled. Thanks for your time, and thanks to the dinner ladies for their cooperation.

clubRequestMail.subject: 求一名踢满全场的前锋
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Wanted: a striker who plays the full 90
clubRequestMail.preview: 我们的前锋上半场世界级，下半场查无此人。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: Our strikers: world-class in the first half, untraceable in the second.
clubRequestMail.body: 我们的情况有点玄：前锋上半场踢得像金球奖候选，下半场就像被外星人换走了。我们不打算追究原因了，只提一个要求：90 分钟都能看见他。如果您手上有这种全场可见型前锋，请立刻联系我们。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: Our situation is a bit spooky: our striker plays like a Ballon d'Or nominee in the first half, then appears to be abducted by aliens at half-time. We've stopped investigating the cause and have just one requirement: visible for the full 90 minutes. If you have one of these full-match-visibility strikers, contact us immediately.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w14.scorer.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 10 名，预期进球与实际进球的差值被统计部门列为情绪敏感数据，不对外公开。
demand.w14.scorer.clubStandingEn: 10th in the league last season; the gap between expected goals and actual goals has been classified by the analytics department as emotionally sensitive data. Not for public release.
demand.w14.scorer.clubBest: 历史最佳：联赛第 6 名；那年的射手王后来被挖走，俱乐部至今保留着印好他名字的球衣库存。
demand.w14.scorer.clubBestEn: Best ever: 6th in the league; that season's top scorer was poached, and the club still holds a stock of shirts with his name already printed.
demand.w14.scorer.clubProfile: 董事会热爱报表，会议室里的柱状图比奖杯多。他们相信足球的本质是一道填空题：把球放进（　）。
demand.w14.scorer.clubProfileEn: The board loves a spreadsheet; the meeting room has more bar charts than trophies. They believe football is essentially a fill-in-the-blank question: put the ball in the ( ).
demand.w14.scorer.titleEn: We need "someone who has scored goals"
demand.w14.scorer.descriptionEn:
No need to explain tactics at length.
As long as he scored plenty in some past season, just send over the CV.
demand.w14.scorer.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 2-3 weeks of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w14.scorer.expiryBody: 您好：董事长在旧货市场淘到一台传真机，从里面翻出一份 2003 年的射手榜，认为上面这些人随便来一个就行。经全组劝说，他改为先看青训营——有个孩子上周进了四个。委托取消。
demand.w14.scorer.expiryBodyEn: Hello: the chairman picked up the fax machine at a car-boot sale, pulled out a 2003 top-scorers chart, and declared any one of those lads would do. After a group intervention he agreed to look at the academy instead — one kid scored four last week. Request cancelled.

clubRequestMail.sender: 数光联 · 招募委员会
clubRequestMail.subject: 寻求一名进过球的人
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Seeking a person who has scored goals
clubRequestMail.preview: 履历上有一栏写着进球很多即可，其余面谈。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: As long as the CV has a column that says "lots of goals", the rest is negotiable.
clubRequestMail.body: 我们的要求很朴素：找一个以前某个赛季进过很多球的前锋。不需要解释战术、哲学或者跑位艺术，把履历发过来就行——进球那一栏请用粗体。如果您推荐的人真的进过很多球，我们的打印机已经准备好合同了。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: Our requirement is simple: find a striker who scored loads of goals in some past season. No need to explain tactics, philosophy or the art of movement — just send the CV, with the goals column in bold. If your man really did score loads, our printer is already warmed up for the contract.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w15.targetman.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 12 名，长传次数联盟第一，短传次数联盟倒数第一。
demand.w15.targetman.clubStandingEn: 12th in the league last season: first for long balls, dead last for short passes.
demand.w15.targetman.clubBest: 历史最佳：升级附加赛决赛失利；赛后全队获评最让对手脖子疼的球队。
demand.w15.targetman.clubBestEn: Best ever: losing play-off finalists; afterwards the squad was voted the team most likely to give opponents a stiff neck.
demand.w15.targetman.clubProfile: 战术手册只有一页：往天上踢，让人去抢。球场边的起重机比角旗更醒目，球迷看球时都戴着安全帽。
demand.w15.targetman.clubProfileEn: The tactical manual is one page: launch it skywards, let the lads fight for it. The crane beside the pitch is more visible than the corner flags; fans wear hard hats to matches.
demand.w15.targetman.titleEn: We need a centre-forward who can take a hit
demand.w15.targetman.descriptionEn:
We play very direct football.
Ideally someone with a stronger body — when the long ball comes in, don't fall over first.
demand.w15.targetman.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 2-3 weeks of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w15.targetman.expiryBody: 先生，麻烦取消委托。我们现有的中锋上周头球破门后自己也晕了半天——队医说这证明球传得够高、人也够硬，凑合能用。主席表示同意。感谢您的奔走，工地上随时欢迎您来搬砖。
demand.w15.targetman.expiryBodyEn: Sir, please cancel the request. Our current target man scored a header last week and was then dizzy for half a day — the club doctor says this proves the cross was high enough and the man hard enough. He'll do. The chairman concurs. Thanks for your efforts; you're welcome to shift bricks on the site any time.

clubRequestMail.subject: 诚聘扛得住人的中锋
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Seeking a target man who can hold his ground
clubRequestMail.preview: 我们的足球很直接：长传，然后祈祷前面有人站得住。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: Our football is direct: long ball, then pray someone's still standing up front.
clubRequestMail.body: 我们踢的是非常直接的足球——门将开大脚，中场再开大脚，前场把球扛下来。现在的中锋一被碰就倒，医务室已经给他办了年卡。我们需要一个身体结实的：长传来了先别摔，剩下的事情慢慢教。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: We play very direct football — the keeper lumps it, the midfield lumps it again, and the man up front holds it up. Our current striker falls over if you breathe on him; the treatment room has issued him an annual pass. We need someone sturdy: when the long ball arrives, don't fall over. We'll teach him the rest later.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w16.academy.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 8 名，一线队平均年龄 21 岁，是联盟唯一赛后集体写作业的球队。
demand.w16.academy.clubStandingEn: 8th in the league last season; average first-team age 21, and the only club in the league where the whole squad does its homework after matches.
demand.w16.academy.clubBest: 历史最佳：青年联赛冠军；奖杯放在校长办公室，因为俱乐部办公室要用来开家长会。
demand.w16.academy.clubBestEn: Best ever: youth league champions; the trophy lives in the headmaster's office, because the club office is needed for parents' evenings.
demand.w16.academy.clubProfile: 以青训闻名，卖出去的球员比留下的多。球探部比一线队部人还多，季票卖得最好的是各队球探席。
demand.w16.academy.clubProfileEn: Famous for the academy — more players sold than kept. The scouting department outnumbers the first-team staff, and the best-selling season tickets are the ones in the visiting scouts' seats.
demand.w16.academy.descriptionEn: The club would like to bring in a young midfielder of around 20 for long-term development.
demand.w16.academy.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 2-3 weeks of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w16.academy.expiryBody: 您好，委托关闭。昨天 U16 梯队有个孩子在中圈吊射进了，视频在教练群里转了三十多次。技术总监看完只说了一句：还买什么，这就是我们要培养的。感谢您的关注，三年后他升一队时欢迎再来。
demand.w16.academy.expiryBodyEn: Hello — request closed. Yesterday an U16 kid scored a lob from the centre circle; the video did the rounds of the coaches' group chat about thirty times. The technical director watched it and said only: why buy anyone — this is exactly what we develop. Thanks for your interest; come back in three years when he's in the first team.

clubRequestMail.subject: 寻找值得长期培养的年轻中场
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Seeking a young midfielder worth a long-term project
clubRequestMail.preview: 我们不买现在，我们投资未来。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: We don't buy the present. We invest in the future.
clubRequestMail.body: 我们想引进一名 20 岁上下的年轻中场，长期培养。不要求即插即用，但要求学得快、听得进话、愿意把这里当成跳板而不是养老院。我们的青训口碑摆在那里：三年后，他要么是我们的核心，要么是您的提成。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: We want a young midfielder, around 20, for long-term development. Doesn't have to be plug-and-play, but must learn fast, take instructions, and treat us as a springboard, not a retirement home. Our academy's reputation speaks for itself: in three years he's either our star or your commission.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w17.headline.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 13 名，但社交媒体粉丝数联盟前五，输球集锦的播放量最高。
demand.w17.headline.clubStandingEn: 13th in the league last season, but top five for social-media followers — our defeat compilations get the most views.
demand.w17.headline.clubBest: 历史最佳：联赛第 9 名；那一周我们上了三次热搜，其中两次跟足球有关。
demand.w17.headline.clubBestEn: Best ever: 9th in the league; we trended three times that week, two of them football-related.
demand.w17.headline.clubProfile: 市场部话语权大于教练组，签约评估表里话题度一栏排在射术前面。主场上座率一般，直播间人气火爆。
demand.w17.headline.clubProfileEn: Marketing outranks the coaching staff; on the signing assessment form, "buzz" sits above "finishing". Home attendance is average; the livestream numbers are on fire.
demand.w17.headline.titleEn: We want to make the news
demand.w17.headline.descriptionEn: Ability isn't actually the priority. A bit of online fame makes him perfect for us.
demand.w17.headline.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 2-3 weeks of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w17.headline.expiryBody: 您好，计划有变：我们本周签约了一位千万粉丝的宠物博主——他家的狗会颠球。市场部认为人不如狗有话题。原委托取消。为表歉意，俱乐部官方账号已关注您，请记得回关。
demand.w17.headline.expiryBodyEn: Hello, the plan has changed: this week we signed a pet influencer with ten million followers — his dog can do keepy-uppies. Marketing concluded dogs trend better than people. The original request is cancelled. By way of apology, the club's official account has followed you. Please follow back.

clubRequestMail.subject: 诚聘有网感的前锋
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Seeking a striker with internet instincts
clubRequestMail.preview: 能力其次，能上热搜者优先。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: Ability secondary. Trending potential preferred.
clubRequestMail.body: 坦白说，我们要的不是射手，是内容。一名自带流量的前锋，进球最好，不进也行——只要他赛后能发一条有梗的动态。球衣分成、直播档期都可以谈。如果您手上有这种会踢球的内容创作者，请立刻联系我们。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: Frankly, we're not after a goalscorer — we're after content. A striker with built-in traffic: goals preferred but optional, as long as he can post one decent meme after the match. Shirt revenue share and streaming slots are all negotiable. If you have a content creator who can also kick a ball, contact us immediately.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部市场部委托 · 第一手信息
clubRequestMail.sourceNoteEn: Club marketing department request · first-hand information

demand.w18.clean.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 6 名，纪律分联盟第一——全年无人迟到，无人染发，无人上八卦版。
demand.w18.clean.clubStandingEn: 6th in the league last season, and first for discipline — all year, nobody was late, nobody dyed their hair, nobody made the gossip pages.
demand.w18.clean.clubBest: 历史最佳：联赛亚军；颁奖典礼上全队八点半准时离场，因为要熄灯。
demand.w18.clean.clubBestEn: Best ever: league runners-up; at the awards ceremony the whole squad left promptly at 8:30, because it was lights-out.
demand.w18.clean.clubProfile: 半军事化青训营，宿舍十点熄灯，手机每周统一检查。培养出的球员以乖著称，球探报告里最常见的评语是家长放心。
demand.w18.clean.clubProfileEn: A semi-military academy: lights out at ten, phones inspected weekly. Its graduates are famous for being well-behaved; the most common line in their scout reports is "parents can relax".
demand.w18.clean.descriptionEn: The club hopes to bring in a young player for long-term development — but requires a spotless private life.
demand.w18.clean.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 2-3 weeks of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w18.clean.expiryBody: 您好，委托暂缓。上周我们面试了一名候选人，天赋极佳，但他手机里有夜店照片——纪律委员会为此开了三个小时会，最终决定先从校内再找一轮。感谢理解。顺带一提，本校熄灯规定同样适用于来访客人。
demand.w18.clean.expiryBodyEn: Hello — request paused. Last week we interviewed a candidate with superb talent, but his phone contained nightclub photos — the discipline committee held a three-hour meeting and ultimately decided to search the campus once more first. Thank you for understanding. Incidentally, our lights-out rule also applies to visiting guests.

clubRequestMail.sender: 圣杯学院 · 教务与球探处
clubRequestMail.senderEn: Holy Grail Academy · Academic & Scouting Office
clubRequestMail.subject: 招募品行端正的年轻中场
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Recruiting a young midfielder of good character
clubRequestMail.preview: 天赋重要，但熄灯后在哪里更重要。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: Talent matters. Where he is after lights-out matters more.
clubRequestMail.body: 我们希望引进一名年轻球员长期培养，技术要求之外还有一条硬规定：私生活检点。我们的球员晚上十点熄灯，周末外出需报备。如果您推荐的年轻人对夜店的了解和对传球路线一样陌生，我们非常欢迎。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: We want to bring in a young player for long-term development, and beyond the technical requirements there's one hard rule: a spotless private life. Our players have lights-out at 10 pm, and weekend trips out must be reported. If your youngster is as unfamiliar with the inside of a nightclub as he is familiar with a passing lane, he is very welcome indeed.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w19.budget.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 14 名，以转会净支出为负还能保级的壮举被财经版报道。
demand.w19.budget.clubStandingEn: 14th in the league last season; survived with negative net transfer spend, a feat covered in the financial pages.
demand.w19.budget.clubBest: 历史最佳：联赛第 10 名；那年全靠免签和租借，被球迷称为白嫖奇迹。
demand.w19.budget.clubBestEn: Best ever: 10th in the league — achieved entirely on free transfers and loans, hailed by the fans as the Freebie Miracle.
demand.w19.budget.clubProfile: 俱乐部座右铭：每一分钱都要进球。办公室灯泡坏了三个月没人换，因为预算里那一栏叫非必要照明。
demand.w19.budget.clubProfileEn: Club motto: every penny must score. The office lightbulb has been dead for three months because the budget line reads "non-essential lighting".
demand.w19.budget.descriptionEn:
Budget is limited, so no big price tags.
The focus is on forwards whose contracts are running down, free agents, or steady scorers in the lower leagues.
demand.w19.budget.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 2-3 weeks of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w19.budget.expiryBody: 球探先生，抱歉。财务总监看到候选人的工资要求后，当场把咖啡喷在了报表上。董事会紧急决定：本赛季改用定位球加祈祷方案，成本为零。委托撤销。若您那边有免费试用的球员，欢迎再谈。
demand.w19.budget.expiryBodyEn: Dear Scout, apologies. When the finance director saw the candidate's wage demands, he spat his coffee straight onto the spreadsheet. The board made an emergency decision: this season we switch to a set-pieces-plus-prayer strategy — zero cost. Request withdrawn. If you have any players on a free trial, do get back in touch.

clubRequestMail.sender: 预算联 · 财务与竞技联席办
clubRequestMail.senderEn: Budget United · Joint Finance & Football Office
clubRequestMail.subject: 低成本射手长期招募
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Long-term recruitment: low-cost goalscorer
clubRequestMail.preview: 贵的不要，会进球的便宜货请来。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: No expensive ones. Bargains who score, please come.
clubRequestMail.body: 开门见山：我们预算有限，不追身价，只看性价比。合同快到期的、自由身的、在低级别联赛稳定进球的——这些是我们的菜。如果您手上有一个别人没注意到的射手，请发资料。我们买不起贵的，但保证他场场首发。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: Straight to the point: our budget is limited — we don't chase price tags, only value for money. Expiring contracts, free agents, steady scorers in the lower leagues: that's our market. If you have a striker nobody else has noticed, send the file. We can't afford expensive, but we guarantee he starts every week.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w21.backup.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 4 名，目前参加洲际冠军联赛资格赛，主力门将保持全勤。
demand.w21.backup.clubStandingEn: 4th in the league last season; currently in Continental Champions League qualifying, with the first-choice keeper ever-present.
demand.w21.backup.clubBest: 历史最佳：杯赛冠军；门将决赛扑出三个点球，从此没人敢跟他争首发，也没人敢当他的替补。
demand.w21.backup.clubBestEn: Best ever: cup winners; the keeper saved three penalties in the final, and since then nobody has dared challenge him for the shirt — or dared be his understudy.
demand.w21.backup.clubProfile: 阵容齐整、目标远大，唯一隐患是门将位置：主力很强，替补是青年队小孩。主席每晚梦见的都是同一件事——主力门将感冒。
demand.w21.backup.clubProfileEn: A complete squad with big ambitions and one soft spot: goalkeeper. The starter is superb; the backup is a youth-team kid. The chairman has the same dream every night — the first-choice keeper catches a cold.
demand.w21.backup.descriptionEn:
Our first-choice keeper is in stable form, but the club wants real competition for the gloves.
We're after an experienced backup who can step into the starting XI at any moment.
demand.w21.backup.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 4 weeks of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w21.backup.expiryBody: 您好，委托取消。青年队小孩上周热身赛扑出一个点球，全队欢呼了五分钟，主席当场宣布我们的未来就在这里。技术总监私下嘟囔那球是冲着立柱去的，但没人理他。感谢关注。
demand.w21.backup.expiryBodyEn: Hello — request cancelled. The youth kid saved a penalty in last week's friendly, the whole squad cheered for five minutes, and the chairman declared on the spot that our future is here. The technical director muttered privately that the shot was heading for the post, but nobody listened. Thanks for your attention.

clubRequestMail.subject: 寻高水平替补门将
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Seeking a high-level backup goalkeeper
clubRequestMail.preview: 首发很稳，但我们想睡个好觉。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: The starter is solid — but we'd like a good night's sleep.
clubRequestMail.body: 我们的主力门将状态稳定，问题也正出在这里——所有人都指望着他一直稳定。我们需要一名经验丰富、随时能进入首发的替补门将：平时压得住阵，万一主力打喷嚏，他能直接接管比赛。这个位置看似替补，实则是全队的保险丝。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: Our first-choice keeper is reliably consistent — and that's exactly the problem: everyone's counting on him staying that way forever. We need an experienced backup who can step straight into the XI: steady on the bench, and if the number one so much as sneezes, ready to take over the match. It's officially a bench role; in practice it's the entire team's insurance policy.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w23.dressing.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 10 名，一线队平均年龄全联盟最小，赛后采访常有人把先生两个字叫成哥哥。
demand.w23.dressing.clubStandingEn: 10th in the league last season with the youngest first team in the league; in post-match interviews the lads keep calling the interviewer "big bro" instead of "sir".
demand.w23.dressing.clubBest: 历史最佳：青年杯双冠；奖杯陈列柜由队员轮流擦灰，因为没人够资历独享这项荣誉。
demand.w23.dressing.clubBestEn: Best ever: Youth Cup double winners; the players take turns dusting the trophy cabinet, because nobody is senior enough to claim the honour alone.
demand.w23.dressing.clubProfile: 青年军当家，冲劲有余、经验欠费。输球后的更衣室安静得可怕——不是愤怒，是没人知道该说什么。
demand.w23.dressing.clubProfileEn: A team run by kids: plenty of hunger, experience subscription expired. The dressing room after a defeat is terrifyingly quiet — not from anger, but because nobody knows what to say.
demand.w23.dressing.descriptionEn:
The squad is very young, so we'd like to add a veteran with a long pro career.
Beyond playing ability, what matters most is leadership and dressing-room presence.
demand.w23.dressing.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 1 week of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w23.dressing.expiryBody: 先生您好，计划取消。梯队教练主动申请复出：我 42 了，资历够老，正好镇场子。首场训练他跑了二十分钟就扶腰，但讲话确实有人听了。委托撤销，感谢您的时间。
demand.w23.dressing.expiryBodyEn: Dear Sir, plan cancelled. The youth-team coach has volunteered to come out of retirement: "I'm 42, senior enough — perfect for keeping the room in line." In his first session he clutched his back after twenty minutes, but people genuinely listen when he talks. Request withdrawn; thank you for your time.

clubRequestMail.subject: 求一名更衣室老大哥
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Wanted: a dressing-room big brother
clubRequestMail.preview: 孩子们需要的不只是教练，是一个活教材。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: The kids need more than a coach — they need a living textbook.
clubRequestMail.body: 我们这支球队很年轻，年轻到队长选举的标准是谁胡子先长出来。我们需要一名有丰富职业经历的老将：竞技上能补位，更衣室里能压场，有人训练迟到时不用教练开口就能把他瞪回去。领导力比体能重要——跑动有小年轻们包干。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: This team is young — so young that the captaincy vote goes to whoever grew a beard first. We need a veteran with a long professional career: able to fill in on the pitch, able to hold the room off it, and able to glare a latecomer back to work without the coach saying a word. Leadership beats fitness — the kids have the running covered.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w24.flank.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 9 名，边路被过次数联盟第二多——第一是已经降级的走廊体育。
demand.w24.flank.clubStandingEn: 9th in the league last season; second-most dribbled-past on the flanks — first place went to Corridor Athletic, who got relegated.
demand.w24.flank.clubBest: 历史最佳：联赛第 5 名；那一年对手的边锋赛后集体接受了心理辅导。
demand.w24.flank.clubBestEn: Best ever: 5th in the league; that season, opposing wingers collectively sought counselling after playing us.
demand.w24.flank.clubProfile: 主教练是边后卫出身，办公室挂着名言：中路丢球是事故，边路丢球是犯罪。球探部门上周提交了四十份报告，全是边后卫。
demand.w24.flank.clubProfileEn: The manager is a former full-back; a motto hangs in his office: "Concede through the middle and it's an accident. Concede down the flank and it's a crime." The scouting department filed forty reports last week — every one a full-back.
demand.w24.flank.descriptionEn: The club wants to strengthen its wide defence. Priority goes to players with sharp tackling, good positioning and strong game-reading.
demand.w24.flank.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 1 week of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w24.flank.expiryBody: 您好，不必再找了。上周末对手边锋全场零过人——不是我们防守变好了，而是他赛前吃坏了肚子。教练认为这证明体系已经成立，引援暂停。感谢奔走，祝您胃口好。
demand.w24.flank.expiryBodyEn: Hello — no need to keep looking. Last weekend their winger completed zero dribbles all match — not because our defence improved, but because he'd eaten something dodgy before the game. The coach takes this as proof the system works; recruitment paused. Thanks for running around, and bon appétit.

clubRequestMail.subject: 急补边路防守
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Urgent: reinforce the flanks
clubRequestMail.preview: 我们的边路目前对外开放，急需关门。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: Our flanks are currently open to the public. We need to close the door.
clubRequestMail.body: 我们的问题很具体：边路防守形同免费通道，对方边锋在我们这一侧刷出了生涯最佳数据。我们需要一名拦截准、位置感好、会阅读比赛的边后卫——进攻花哨与否无所谓，先把自家走廊的门锁上。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: Our problem is specific: the flank is basically a toll-free motorway, and opposing wingers post career-best numbers down our side. We need a full-back who times his tackles, reads the game, and holds his position — attacking flair optional. First, lock the door of our corridor.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w25.chairman.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 11 名，董事长以 52 岁高龄在友谊赛出场 12 分钟，跑动 400 米，触球一次。
demand.w25.chairman.clubStandingEn: 11th in the league last season; the chairman, aged 52, played 12 minutes of a friendly, covered 400 metres, and touched the ball once.
demand.w25.chairman.clubBest: 历史最佳：联赛第 8 名；董事长把那年的全队合照放大挂在大厅，照片里他站在最中间。
demand.w25.chairman.clubBestEn: Best ever: 8th in the league; the chairman had that year's squad photo enlarged and hung in the lobby. He is standing in the very middle.
demand.w25.chairman.clubProfile: 赞助商名单很短：董事长自己的三家公司。训练基地的标语是快乐足球——主要是董事长一个人的快乐。
demand.w25.chairman.clubProfileEn: The sponsor list is short: the chairman's own three companies. The training-ground slogan is Happy Football — chiefly the chairman's happiness.
demand.w25.chairman.descriptionEn: The boss wants to play on the pitch himself, and hopes to find a top-class passing midfielder to meet his needs.
demand.w25.chairman.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 1 week of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w25.chairman.expiryBody: 球探先生，遗憾地通知您：董事长上周队内赛送出一次助攻，心情大好，宣布现有中场已完全够用。技术总监试图解释那是梯队小孩让的，被请去喝了茶。委托暂缓，祝您工作顺利。
demand.w25.chairman.expiryBodyEn: Dear Scout, we regret to inform you: the chairman registered an assist in last week's in-house match, was delighted, and declared the current midfield entirely sufficient. The technical director attempted to explain that the academy kid let him have it, and was invited for a cup of tea. Request paused; wishing you smooth work.

clubRequestMail.sender: 主席联 · 俱乐部办公室
clubRequestMail.subject: 招募传球型中场（内部需求）
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Recruiting a passing midfielder (internal request)
clubRequestMail.preview: 董事长有一个梦想，需要一脚好传球来圆。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: The chairman has a dream, and it takes one good pass to complete.
clubRequestMail.body: 这是一份特殊委托：我们董事长热爱足球，本赛季计划亲自登场。为保证他的比赛体验——以及俱乐部的商业运转——我们需要一名传球水平高的中场，能把球舒舒服服送到董事长脚下。其他职责面议。请注意：本条需求请勿外传。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: This is a special request: our chairman loves football and plans to make a personal appearance this season. To guarantee his match experience — and the club's commercial operations — we need a midfielder with elite passing who can deliver the ball comfortably to the chairman's feet. Other duties negotiable. Please note: do not circulate this request.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部内部委托 · 请勿声张
clubRequestMail.sourceNoteEn: Internal club request · please keep this quiet

demand.w26.goldpan.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 13 名，但卖人收入联盟前三，被业内称为足坛二手市场。
demand.w26.goldpan.clubStandingEn: 13th in the league last season, but top three for income from player sales — known in the trade as football's second-hand market.
demand.w26.goldpan.clubBest: 历史最佳：杯赛四强；主力阵容里有四个豪门弃将，赛后对方主席拒绝对此发表评论。
demand.w26.goldpan.clubBestEn: Best ever: cup semi-finalists with four big-club rejects in the starting XI; the other chairman declined to comment after the match.
demand.w26.goldpan.clubProfile: 经营哲学：别人扔掉的，我们擦亮再卖。更衣室储物柜都是二手的——据说有一个曾属于某位巨星，俱乐部打算等升值。
demand.w26.goldpan.clubProfileEn: Business philosophy: what others throw away, we polish and resell. Even the dressing-room lockers are second-hand — one supposedly belonged to a superstar, and the club is holding it until it appreciates.
demand.w26.goldpan.descriptionEn:
We believe there are still plenty of gems among the players the big clubs gave up on.
If he's not too old, we can talk seriously.
demand.w26.goldpan.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 1 week of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w26.goldpan.expirySubjectEn: This round of gold-panning is done
demand.w26.goldpan.expiryBody: 先生，委托关闭。上周我们免签了一名被豪门放弃的小孩，首场就进球了。经理兴奋之余把引援预算改成了他的续约奖金。本期淘金结束，欢迎下次再来——最好赶在我们把他卖掉之前。
demand.w26.goldpan.expiryBodyEn: Sir — request closed. Last week we signed a kid a big club had given up on, free of charge, and he scored on his debut. In his excitement the manager converted the transfer budget into the lad's renewal bonus. This panning season is over; come again next time — ideally before we sell him.

clubRequestMail.subject: 长期收购：被放弃的好东西
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Always buying: good things others gave up on
clubRequestMail.preview: 大俱乐部不要的人，正是我们要的人。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: Whoever the big clubs don't want is exactly who we want.
clubRequestMail.body: 我们坚信一个道理：被大俱乐部放弃的球员里还有很多好东西——他们只是没赶上好时机、好教练或者好发型。我们找的就是这种二手精品：年纪不大、憋着一口气、价格好谈。如果您手上有这种失意但好用的前锋，请优先联系我们。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: We hold one truth: among the players big clubs discard, there's plenty of good stock — they just missed the right moment, the right coach, or the right haircut. We deal in exactly these second-hand gems: young, with a point to prove, priced to talk. If you have a down-on-his-luck but useful striker, contact us first.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w27.physical.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 12 名，对抗成功次数中游，但对方赛后冰敷袋消耗量联盟第一。
demand.w27.physical.clubStandingEn: 12th in the league last season; mid-table for duels won, but first in the league for opponents' post-match ice-pack consumption.
demand.w27.physical.clubBest: 历史最佳：联赛第 9 名；那个赛季有六支球队申请把与我们的比赛改期，理由是场地积水。
demand.w27.physical.clubBestEn: Best ever: 9th in the league — the season when six clubs applied to reschedule matches against us, citing a waterlogged pitch.
demand.w27.physical.clubProfile: 训练基地的健身房比战术室大三倍。票务广告词是来看一场真正的身体足球，配图是一副担架。
demand.w27.physical.clubProfileEn: At the training ground, the gym is three times the size of the tactics room. The ticket ad reads "come watch some real physical football" — illustrated with a stretcher.
demand.w27.physical.descriptionEn:
The team needs a physically strong player with an aggressive attitude.
Budget is limited, so no fame required — we just want opponents to feel his presence once he's on the pitch.
demand.w27.physical.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 1 week of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w27.physical.expiryBody: 您好，招募取消。昨天队内对抗赛，我们队长和副队长撞在一起双双倒地，队医称内部消耗已达上限。教练决定改练技术流。委托撤销。两位队长目前恢复良好，已能自主进食。
demand.w27.physical.expiryBodyEn: Hello — recruitment cancelled. In yesterday's practice match, our captain and vice-captain collided with each other and both went down; the club doctor says internal attrition has reached its limit. The coach has decided to work on technical football instead. Request withdrawn. Both captains are recovering well and can already feed themselves.

clubRequestMail.subject: 求一名让对手有体感的后卫
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Wanted: a defender opponents can physically feel
clubRequestMail.preview: 不求名气，只求对手赛后记得他。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: No fame required — just opponents who remember him after the match.
clubRequestMail.body: 我们预算不高，买不起明星，但我们想买一种感觉：对手穿上球衣就开始后悔的感觉。我们需要一名身体对抗强、比赛态度积极的球员——上场以后，对方前锋要能清楚地感觉到他的存在。如果您推荐的人能让对面申请换人，我们加钱。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: Our budget is modest — we can't buy stars, but we can buy a feeling: the feeling opponents get when they put on the shirt and start regretting it. We need a player with real physicality and an aggressive attitude — once he's on, their striker should be acutely aware of his presence. If your man makes the other side beg for a substitution, we'll pay extra.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w28.noill.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 10 名，队医工作量联盟第一，理疗室已扩建两次并申报了建筑奖。
demand.w28.noill.clubStandingEn: 10th in the league last season; first for club-doctor workload. The physio room has been extended twice and submitted for an architecture award.
demand.w28.noill.clubBest: 历史最佳：联赛第 7 名；那是队史唯一全员健康的赛季，被载入年鉴，标题是奇迹年。
demand.w28.noill.clubBestEn: Best ever: 7th in the league — the only fully-fit season in club history, entered in the yearbook under the heading "The Miracle Year".
demand.w28.noill.clubProfile: 体检设备比训练设备先进，签约流程里体检要过三关。俱乐部餐厅禁止油炸食品，甜品需要队医签字批准。
demand.w28.noill.clubProfileEn: The medical equipment is more advanced than the training equipment; the signing process includes three stages of medicals. The canteen bans fried food, and desserts require the club doctor's signature.
demand.w28.noill.descriptionEn: We'd like to find a player who simply never gets ill.
demand.w28.noill.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 4 weeks of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w28.noill.expiryBody: 球探先生，告诉您一个好消息：本周全员体检，十一人全部通过——队史首次。主席激动得哭了，当场宣布天不亡我，引援暂停。另外队医提议把本周定为俱乐部健康纪念日，正在走流程。
demand.w28.noill.expiryBodyEn: Dear Scout, wonderful news: at this week's full-squad medical, all eleven passed — a club first. The chairman burst into tears and declared on the spot that heaven has not forsaken us; recruitment is paused. The club doctor has also proposed designating this week as Club Health Memorial Day. Paperwork is in progress.

clubRequestMail.sender: 不锈联 · 医疗与竞技委员会
clubRequestMail.subject: 诚聘不会生病的中场
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Seeking a midfielder who never gets ill
clubRequestMail.preview: 我们的要求很简单：一直健康，永远健康。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: Our requirement is simple: healthy always, healthy forever.
clubRequestMail.body: 我们受过太多伤。过去三年，医务室接待过的球员快赶上主场球迷了（夸张修辞，但不多）。所以这次引援只有一个标准：找一个不会生病、不易受伤的球员。技术可以练，体能可以调，基因我们没办法——请帮我们把好这一关。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: We've suffered too many injuries. Over the past three years the treatment room has seen almost as many players as the home stands have seen fans (a slight exaggeration — but only slight). So this signing has one criterion: someone who doesn't get ill and doesn't get hurt. Technique can be coached, fitness can be built — genes we can't fix. Please guard that gate for us.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w30.biggame.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 5 名、杯赛四强——联赛靠实力，淘汰赛靠的全是经验。
demand.w30.biggame.clubStandingEn: 5th in the league last season and cup semi-finalists — the league runs on quality; the knockouts run purely on experience.
demand.w30.biggame.clubBest: 历史最佳：洲际赛事八强；首回合落后三球次回合逆转，那场球被剪成每年新援的入职培训片。
demand.w30.biggame.clubBestEn: Best ever: continental quarter-finalists; three goals down after the first leg, we turned it round in the second. That match is cut into the induction video every new signing must watch.
demand.w30.biggame.clubProfile: 阵容不差，缺的是见过大场面的人。关键战役前，更衣室墙上会投影对手球场照片，据说是为了提前适应紧张。
demand.w30.biggame.clubProfileEn: The squad is decent; what's missing is someone who's seen the big occasion. Before crunch ties, photos of the opponent's stadium are projected on the dressing-room wall — supposedly to acclimatise everyone to being nervous.
demand.w30.biggame.descriptionEn:
League numbers aren't the priority.
A player who has featured in the Champions League, Europa League or Conference League — and scored in big games — would be very attractive.
demand.w30.biggame.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 4 weeks of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w30.biggame.expiryBody: 先生您好，招募取消。我们的老队长看完半决赛录像后宣布再踢一年：这帮孩子在点球点前腿软的样子，我实在看不下去。虽然他上赛季场均跑动只有八千米，但气场八千米都不止。感谢关注。
demand.w30.biggame.expiryBodyEn: Dear Sir, recruitment cancelled. Our old captain watched the semi-final tape and announced he'd play one more year: "I can't bear watching these kids' legs turn to jelly at the penalty spot." He only averaged eight kilometres a match last season, but his aura covers far more than eight kilometres. Thanks for your attention.

clubRequestMail.sender: 淘汰赛联 · 技术总监
clubRequestMail.subject: 寻找关键比赛型中场
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Seeking a big-match midfielder
clubRequestMail.preview: 联赛数据不重要，大场面的心跳才重要。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: League stats don't matter. A big-game heartbeat does.
clubRequestMail.body: 跟您交底：我们联赛踢得还行，一进淘汰赛就变成另一支队——腿比球快，心比腿慌。我们需要一名踢过欧冠、欧联或欧协联、在关键比赛进过球的中场。数据表可以难看，但他站上大场面的那一刻，必须像回家一样。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: Cards on the table: we're fine in the league, but turn into a different team in the knockouts — legs faster than the ball, hearts faster than the legs. We need a midfielder who's played in the Champions League, Europa League or Conference League and scored in a big match. His numbers can be ugly, but when he steps onto the big stage, it must feel like coming home.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w33.counter.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 6 名，场均控球率倒数第三，反击进球数正数第三。
demand.w33.counter.clubStandingEn: 6th in the league last season: third-lowest average possession, third-highest counter-attack goals.
demand.w33.counter.clubBest: 历史最佳：联赛季军；整季场均控球 38%，主教练把那年的战术板捐给了博物馆，标题是少即是多。
demand.w33.counter.clubBestEn: Best ever: third in the league with 38% average possession all season; the manager donated that year's tactics board to a museum, titled "Less Is More".
demand.w33.counter.clubProfile: 全队速度至上，训练第一课是三秒内完成由守转攻。门将手抛球时速有专人统计，后卫的第一脚长传被当作进攻发起点评分。
demand.w33.counter.clubProfileEn: Speed above all; the first lesson of training is defence to attack in three seconds. The keeper's throw-out speed is officially tracked, and a defender's first long ball is graded as a point of attack.
demand.w33.counter.descriptionEn:
The team wants to sharpen its transition from defence to attack.
A player who can find the striker directly from the back would fit perfectly.
demand.w33.counter.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 4 weeks of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w33.counter.expiryBody: 您好，委托取消。上周热身赛，我们的中卫一脚六十米长传直接助攻，教练组反复看了二十遍录像，决定此人就是答案。虽然他其余八十九分钟表现平平，但体系球员就是这么定义的。感谢奔走。
demand.w33.counter.expiryBodyEn: Hello — request cancelled. In last week's friendly, our centre-back assisted directly with a 60-metre long ball; the coaching staff watched the tape twenty times and decided he is the answer. He was ordinary for the other 89 minutes, but that's precisely how a system player is defined. Thanks for your efforts.

clubRequestMail.subject: 寻找后场出球型后卫
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Seeking a ball-playing defender
clubRequestMail.preview: 我们的进攻从后卫脚下开始，三秒内到前场。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: Our attacks start at the defender's feet and reach the final third in three seconds.
clubRequestMail.body: 我们的战术一句话讲完：抢下球，三秒内找到前锋。所以那名后卫至关重要——他要能从后场直接把球送到前锋脚下，省掉中间所有客套。如果您手上有这种后场制导型球员，请尽快联系，我们的前锋已经等得不耐烦了。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: Our tactics in one sentence: win the ball, find the striker within three seconds. Which makes that defender absolutely vital — he must deliver the ball from the back straight to the striker's feet, skipping all the pleasantries in between. If you have one of these back-line guided missiles, contact us soon; our forwards are getting impatient.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w36.blindside.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 8 名，看不见的地方进球占全队一半——另一半是定位球。
demand.w36.blindside.clubStandingEn: 8th in the league last season; half our goals came from unseen places — the other half from set pieces.
demand.w36.blindside.clubBest: 历史最佳：联赛第 6 名；那年十佳球集锦里，有六个进球连解说员都没看清是谁进的。
demand.w36.blindside.clubBestEn: Best ever: 6th in the league; in that season's top-ten goals reel, even the commentator couldn't tell who scored six of them.
demand.w36.blindside.clubProfile: 主教练痴迷无球跑动，训练课上得最多的是如何从后卫背后长出来。队内流传一句话：持球是责任，无球是艺术。
demand.w36.blindside.clubProfileEn: The manager is obsessed with off-ball movement; the most-taught lesson in training is how to grow out of a defender's back. A saying circulates in the squad: on the ball is duty, off the ball is art.
demand.w36.blindside.descriptionEn:
We want the new winger to keep arriving in the box from the blind side.
He doesn't even need many touches — as long as he can run.
demand.w36.blindside.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 4 weeks of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w36.blindside.expiryBody: 先生，不必麻烦了。上周青年队比赛，一名小孩从盲区插上进了两个——第二个连现场摄影师都没跟上。主教练看完沉默良久，说：就是他了。委托撤销。那孩子现正接受如何被镜头捕捉的培训。
demand.w36.blindside.expiryBodyEn: Sir — no further trouble needed. In last week's youth match, a kid arrived from the blind side to score two; even the on-site cameraman missed the second. The manager watched in long silence, then said: "He's the one." Request withdrawn. The lad is currently in training on how to be captured on camera.

clubRequestMail.sender: 盲刃联 · 主教练办公室
clubRequestMail.senderEn: Blindside Blades FC · Head Coach's Office
clubRequestMail.subject: 诚聘无球跑动型边锋
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Seeking an off-ball-movement winger
clubRequestMail.preview: 不需要你拿球，需要你不被看见。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: We don't need you on the ball. We need you unseen.
clubRequestMail.body: 我们要找一名特殊的边锋：他不需要大量持球，甚至越少碰球越好。他的工作是从后卫的盲区里长出来，在所有人看球的时候出现在球要去的地方。如果您手上有这种幽灵型球员，请告诉我们——对手的后卫会感谢他的。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: We're after a special kind of winger: he doesn't need many touches — the fewer the better. His job is to grow out of the defender's blind spot and be where the ball is going while everyone else is watching where it is. If you have one of these ghost-type players, tell us — the opposition's defenders will thank him.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息

demand.w39.thin.clubStanding: 上赛季联赛第 15 名，以 19 人阵容撑完全季，替补席常年比看台还空。
demand.w39.thin.clubStandingEn: 15th in the league last season, surviving the whole campaign with a 19-man squad; the bench is permanently emptier than the stands.
demand.w39.thin.clubBest: 历史最佳：联赛第 9 名；那年全队共用三双护腿板，获评最具可持续性俱乐部。
demand.w39.thin.clubBestEn: Best ever: 9th in the league — the season the whole squad shared three pairs of shin pads, earning the club the title of Most Sustainable Club.
demand.w39.thin.clubProfile: 财政困难，预算表精确到胶带卷数。俱乐部口号是一个顶三——不只是战术理念，更是财务政策。
demand.w39.thin.clubProfileEn: Financial difficulties; the budget is itemised down to rolls of tape. The club slogan is "one man does the job of three" — not just a tactical philosophy, but a financial policy.
demand.w39.thin.descriptionEn:
A financially troubled club hopes to shrink the squad.
If one player can cover three positions, he gets clear priority.
demand.w39.thin.paymentTermsEn: Feedback within 4 weeks of submission; payment on successful placement.
demand.w39.thin.expiryBody: 球探先生，委托暂缓。财务部门算出引进一人的差旅体检费够发全队两周伙食，主席沉吟许久，决定先让现有球员再多兼一个位置试试。边锋已开始加练守门，据说手套是借的。感谢理解。
demand.w39.thin.expiryBodyEn: Dear Scout, request paused. Finance calculated that one signing's travel and medical costs would cover two weeks of food for the whole squad; the chairman pondered long and hard, and decided to first try having current players cover one more position each. The winger has begun extra goalkeeping practice — the gloves are reportedly borrowed. Thank you for understanding.

clubRequestMail.sender: 紧缩竞技 · 生存与发展办公室
clubRequestMail.senderEn: Austerity Athletic · Office of Survival & Development
clubRequestMail.subject: 招募一人多能的边后卫
clubRequestMail.subjectEn: Recruiting a multi-position wing-back
clubRequestMail.preview: 预算有限，梦想不限，一个位置的钱办三个位置的事。
clubRequestMail.previewEn: Limited budget, unlimited dreams: one position's wages, three positions' work.
clubRequestMail.body: 直说：我们财政困难，正在缩减阵容人数。所以我们需要一名能胜任多个位置的球员——边后卫为主，最好能兼顾中场和边锋。一个人顶三个人，我们会给予明显优先级。工资按一个人的发，出场机会按三个人的给，童叟无欺。
clubRequestMail.bodyEn: Straight up: we're in financial trouble and cutting the squad down. So we need a player who covers multiple positions — wing-back first, ideally midfield and wing too. One man doing the job of three gets obvious priority. Wages paid as one man; minutes given as three. Fair to young and old alike.
clubRequestMail.sourceNote: 俱乐部正式招聘 · 第一手信息
